economic_hypothesis: Three separated approaches to an endogenous price boundary with smaller intervening retreats may indicate depletion of opposing liquidity while persistent demand remains. The directional forecast is toward that boundary before a breakout. OHLC is a price-memory proxy: no claim that order inventory or liquidity replenishment is directly observed.
net_rationale: Only native minimum tickets passing the accepted EUR200 cost/risk/margin gate are considered. Prior full price range must translate to at least twice the full roundtrip cost reference. This is ex-ante excursion headroom, not an expected-profit estimate. The pilot tests whether the hypothesized pressure overcomes spread, both commissions, signed FX, PnL conversion fees, 2bps slippage each side and financing stress.
input: Twelve native closed M5 OHLC bars, opening times t-3900 through t-600; all fully published at t-300, entry at t. No L2, fills, cross-provider information, calendar or session-closure authority is required.
rule: U=max highs, L=min lows, R=U-L. Upper contact high>=U-0.1R, lower contact low<=L+0.1R. Collapse consecutive contacts. Last three clusters must end on bar11; retreat depths d1>=0.2R, d2>=0.1R, d2<=0.75d1. Last close must be between 0.02R and 0.25R inside the boundary. Exactly one side qualifies. Enter toward boundary only if native entry mid remains inside it. No thresholds are fitted.
direction: toward qualifying boundary; ties cash; no inversion after outcomes
comparators: same-event sign of completed 12-bar body, same minimum volume and fixed exit
primary_quotes: STRICT5S with <=2s side skew, authenticated complete quote coverage and signed FX routes
proxy_quote_rescue: FORBIDDEN;STATE300S not used to rescue support

gates.rule: All real counts must pass. Availability gating uses no future directional returns. All entry candidates remain enrolled, including censored exits; no availability rank or substitution.

falsifier: Paired model NET <=0 or increment over own-body comparator <=0 closes this exact without promotion. A positive result is exploratory only; three previously adaptively exposed weeks cannot certify alpha.
stop_conditions: unknown selected portfolio exit or mark halts causal ledger
no automatic restart on technical failure
unqualified support is a data limitation, not a negative profit result
portfolio: Chronological HEDGED concurrent positions and pending intents; rank only entry cost then native identity; minimum volume; marked equity; aggregate planned risk<=1%, margin<=40%, reserve>=60%. Existing open exposure counts. Funding and margin are conservative current-term reference estimates, not historical execution guarantees.

novelty.breakout_families: Entry remains inside the level; no completed range escape is required. The tested input is contraction of separated retreat depths, not price crossing or volume confirmation.
novelty.failed_breakout_wick: No penetration-and-failure event and no single-bar wick fade; direction is toward boundary.
novelty.nominal_round_barrier: Endogenous visited price level, not a digit-defined round level; continuation pressure instead of reflection.
novelty.RTC_AIDR: No adjacent-H1 range translation or return/activity acceleration ratio; contact topology and retreat sequence can differ with the same overall OHLC/body.
novelty.extrema_order_and_signed_variation: Neither extrema chronology nor temporal ordering of return/variation fixes multiple local retreat depths.
novelty.limit: The broad economic family is price pressure/microstructure. Exact distinctness does not by itself prove a distinct latent cause; inventory exhaustion remains an explicitly falsifiable interpretation.

repeated_selection: One newly registered exact; no hyperparameter sweep, no holdout/protected data, no global significance claim, reuse all closed exact decisions without outcomes replay.
if_unqualified_next_review: NATIVE_FX_CLOSED_CYCLE_EXECUTABLE_DISCREPANCY: compare against accepted complete cross-currency/cross-instrument discrepancy definitions before any outcome. Reject an equivalent exact; do not run it or invert the pressure signal to manufacture another candidate.
final_cloud: Native C# pure kernel + MarketData.GetBars M5, native tick BID/ASK timestamps and native FX symbols. Live quote timing parity, actual fills and restart-to-position reconciliation remain uncertified. No deployment or orders.
